clips.title: The story
paras: In the Oracle Glade, a strange plant casts a twisting, shimmering aura. Its fronds come from a species native to the Swamp of Sorrows, far across the Great Sea.

A radiant plant grows among the trees near the Oracle Glade. Its aura pulses, and its fronds shimmer in the woodland light. Denalan, who tends planters beside Lake Al'Ameth, recognizes the leaves as belonging to a species from the Swamp of Sorrows in the Eastern Kingdoms. How seeds from that distant marsh crossed the Great Sea and took root on Teldrassil remains a mystery. Denalan is growing specimens in his own soil to study them.
